finding.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in a Command ('Command Injection')
finding.summary: An unsanitized display_name from the Flask request handler in profile_controller.py flows through a ProfileUpdate DTO in profile_service.py and into redis_command_relay.py, where it is concatenated into a hand-built Redis inline HSET command and sent over a raw socket, letting an embedded CRLF sequence inject additional Redis commands.
